messages:
Maya: Hey team — need to swap my Sun 03:00-09:00 UTC oncall. Flight got rebooked to a red-eye. Can someone take it? Happy to hand off full notes. Link: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/oncall

Devin: I can take 04:00-09:00 but I need someone to cover 03:00-04:00. @Sam any chance?

Sam: I can do 03:00-05:00, then Devin picks up. Quick Q — any planned deploys or canaries that night?

Maya: No planned deploys overnight, but note: canary rollout for model redwood-v2 at Sat 23:00 UTC. If rollback didn't finish cleanly it can leave some variants degraded into Sun early AM. TL;DR: watch error rate on /v1/generate for model=redwood-v2 and check fallback routing.

Maya: Handoff checklist (short):
- Warm caches: `scripts/cache_warm.sh --models redwood-v2,redwood-v1 --duration 10m`
- Health checks:
  - `curl -sS https://api.redwood.internal/health | jq .`
  - `kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o wide`
- If spike in 5xxs: switch routing to fallback policy: `POST /admin/route?policy=fallback-v1` (internal only)

Maya: Runbook excerpt:
```
If model errors > 1% for 5m:
1) Pause canary via `deployctl pause canary redwood-v2`
2) Increase concurrency limit on dedicated pool: `adminctl set-pool --name=d1 --concurrency=200`
3) Notify infra oncall and post in #incidents
```

Oliver: FYI I left a cached prewarm job running on prod that should keep latency low until ~04:30.

oncall-bot: Rotation updated: Maya -> Sam (03:00-05:00), Sam -> Devin (05:00-09:00). Reminder scheduled 30m before shift.

Sam: Got it. I'll take 03:00-05:00. @Devin please confirm pick at 04:45 so I can handoff.

Devin: Confirmed. I'll be online 04:40 and will run the prewarm steps below. Also ping if you see persistent `cuda OOM` logs — infra fix hasn't reached all nodes.

Devin: Prewarm snippet:
```
# run on ops box
ssh ops@prod && /opt/redwood/bin/prewarm --models redwood-v2 --parallel 6
```

Maya: Thanks team :heart: I'll leave Slack DND off for 45m before shift. Leaving a note in PagerDuty with contact details and the gist of prior failures: https://gist.github.com/maya/xxxx (shows fallback triggered twice).

Sam: :thumbsup: I'll post a quick mini-thread at 04:05 if I see anything odd, otherwise quiet handoff at 04:45.

Maya: Done — appreciate it, and sorry for the last-minute swap. If you need any deeper context ping me or check the runbook link above.
